body.x: ZTYLUS(www.ztylus.com), creating the first revolver camera kit with its line of premium smartphone photography kit and continuing to redefine the consumer electronics and photography markets with its product lines, unveiled METAL ZIP-6KG at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.The Ztylus Metal case for the iPhone 6 (4.7) is the new leader in protective cases providing full body protection. The ZIP-6 Case for the iPhone 6 (4.7”) features a removable kickstand disk that can be detached and replaced with Ztylus Revolver Lens Attachment & LED Ring Light Attachment.
